title: Outpaint flow - extend the frame on a crop gizmo, Krea 2 fills the black
description: Outpaint Flow - drop an image, extend the frame past its edges on a crop gizmo, and let Krea 2 paint the black area back in. Fabio's raw graph is comfy_workflows/raw/flow_outpaint.json (Krea2 edit; Input_Image is a PATH-reading MpiLoadImageFromPath, Input_Positive is baked as 'fill the back areas with the rest of the image', plus Input_Negative / Input_Seed / Input_is_Turbo / Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora; Output_Image). THE IMAGE THE GRAPH GETS IS ALREADY PADDED - the app composes source + black bars and hands over that file, the graph does no padding. New step kind 'crop' (MpiStepCrop) reuses CropManager.js wholesale (unclamped rect, cropSnap.js edge snapping, dashed source bounds, handles) so it behaves exactly like the History crop tool, with a CROP_RATIOS ratio bar + orientation toggle under the canvas. Run slide = Generate + a Turbo toggle, nothing else. Copy must warn that SMALL extensions work best - big ones invent too much. Procedure: docs/playbooks/add-flow/.
